entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker ghost-assassin and former Orzhov guildmaster, hired anonymously to hunt a monster devouring townsfolk on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: The blind clan leader of the Omenseekers, whose white sight knows where her clan members go and who casts holding spells with a lantern.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: A god of Kaldheim who travels in mortal guise as the old Omenseeker advisor Asi, with a raven Hakka, and who shields the party and promises Cosima's longship.

entities.name: Hakka
entities.description: The raven that perches on Asi's shoulder and brings him information.

entities.name: Hras
entities.description: A young hunter of Sevalgr who saw the monster.

entities.name: Hersir
entities.description: The leader of the village of Sevalgr.

entities.name: Monster
entities.description: A twelve-foot pink-fleshed monster with fused extra arms and bone-like mask that absorbs people, regenerates, and flees into a metal vein in the cave.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: A Cosmos Monster, a wolf said to eat realms, feared by an Omenseeker as the culprit.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: A god of Kaldheim whose longship will aid Kaya.

entities.name: Toski
entities.description: The squirrel messenger of the gods.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A clan of legendary explorers led by Inga Rune-Eyes, with tattooed navigational maps.

entities.name: Cosmos Monsters
entities.description: Beings created at the birth of the world who dwell in the void between realms.

entities.name: Sevalgr
entities.description: A fishing village that has lost many people to disappearances.

entities.name: Aldergard
entities.description: An old and strange forest near Sevalgr, where the monster's cave lies.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The realm of Kaldheim where the events occur.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The giant tree linking the realms of Kaldheim, visible in the sky.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: A realm whose light atop the World Tree will guide Kaya.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: A realm of demons.

entities.name: Kirda Pillars
entities.description: The place from which Kaya traveled with the Omenseekers.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The Viking plane of nine realms.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Kaya recently left behind.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A collision of the realms bringing war and chaos, which Alrund fears approaches.

entities.name: Cosima's longship
entities.description: A god's longship that can travel between realms, promised to Kaya.

events.summary: Omenseekers arrive by ship at Sevalgr, a village plagued by disappearances.
events.quote: There could be no mistaking them. Omenseekers.

events.summary: Villagers say the disappearances are murders, and a young hunter, Hras, reports that a monster did it.
events.quote: A monster. It was a monster.

events.summary: Inga orders a war party into the Aldergard forest, noting Kaya came up with the idea.
events.quote: I want a war party ready to set off within the hour.

events.summary: In the Aldergard, Asi and an Omenseeker discuss whether the culprit is the Cosmos Monster Sarulf.
events.quote: He is one of the Cosmos Monsters.

events.summary: Asi's raven Hakka returns and leads the party to a cave.
events.quote: my friend may have found us a lead

events.summary: In the cave Kaya spots strange metallic veins and warns an Omenseeker not to touch them.
events.quote: veins of some kind of metal ran along the wall and ceiling of the cave

events.summary: The party finds a monster feeding on a dire bear; it kills Omenseekers by fusing with and absorbing them.
events.quote: one was pinned beneath the creature, screaming as the spindly arms sank into his face

events.summary: Inga freezes the monster's arm with a lantern spell and Kaya severs it with her dagger.
events.quote: lopping it off at the shoulder

events.summary: The monster absorbs a dead Omenseeker and regrows its arm.
events.quote: He disappeared into the raw pink flesh, slowly absorbed.

events.summary: Kaya phases through the cave wall to escape being cornered and then cuts through one of the monster's legs.
events.quote: she jammed all the arcane power she could muster into her blade and lunged

events.summary: Asi glows with divine light, revealed as Alrund, and shields the party with a barrier; the monster flees into the metal vein.
events.quote: it seemed to sink into the metal, as it if were a thick and viscous liquid

events.summary: Alrund explains gods travel in mortal guise and Kaya berates him for letting the monster escape.
events.quote: It suits the gods, from time to time, to travel in mortal guise

events.summary: Alrund promises Kaya the longship of Cosima to pursue the creature across realms.
events.quote: the longship of Cosima will aid you in this quest

events.summary: Alrund opens a doorway into the void and warns of a coming Doomskar.
events.quote: I fear a Doomskar approaches—one unlike any in living memory.

relations.quote: Inga Rune-Eyes, the clan leader of the Omenseekers

relations.note: Asi has been her advisor; he is actually the god Alrund.
relations.quote: those sightless white eyes stayed fixed on her former advisor

relations.note: Kaya hunts the monster alongside Inga's party.
relations.quote: Inga, leader of the Omenseekers, was the first person Kaya had met on this plane

relations.note: Kaya hunts and fights the monster.
It kills and absorbs Omenseekers in the cave.
relations.quote: He disappeared into the raw pink flesh, slowly absorbed.
